title: Contest Session Log Event
description: openvela AI Contest session log single-event schema (v1.0). Each JSONL line MUST satisfy this schema.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Initial release fixed at 1.0.

session_id.description: Internal session ID from the AI tool, e.g. ses_xxx.

team_id.description: Team ID (e.g. contest2026-042-app), provided via TEAM_ID env var.

github_login.description: GitHub username identifying the specific producer (team member) of this event.

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the event occurred.

seq.description: Per-session monotonic sequence number starting at 0, incremented by 1 per event. Used for resume + tamper detection.

text.description: Text content for user / assistant / system events. Preserved in full, no truncation.

thinking.description: Assistant extended thinking / reasoning content (when exposed by the tool).

tool_name.description: (Required when role=tool) Tool name, e.g. read / edit / bash.

tool_call_id.description: (Required when role=tool) Unique tool invocation ID.

input.description: (role=tool only) Tool arguments. Kept as a structured object, not serialized into a string.

tokens_in.description: (Optional) Input token count. Required for token-plan upgrade audits.

files_touched.description: (Optional) List of file paths read/written during this event.

cwd.description: (Optional) The plugin's working directory at the time of the event.

metadata.description: (Optional) Tool execution metadata (timing, exit code, etc.).

redacted_count.description: (Optional) Number of redaction substitutions applied to this event, for audit.

allOf.description: When role=tool, tool_name and tool_call_id MUST be present.
